entry.summary: St Helena: Australia isn't on the e-visa (visa-national) list, so you get a short-term entry permit at the border (up to 183 days). There is no visa on arrival for visa nationals. Ascension Island needs an e-visa for everyone, applied for at least 14 days ahead.
entry.next_check: Confirm with Saint Helena, Ascension and Tristan da Cunha's government.

culture-and-protocol.dress_and_conduct: Ask locally. St Helena Tourism says to greet people you pass and wave to drivers. Most shops close on Sundays. Bring GBP cash or arrange the Bank of St Helena Tourist Card, because there are no ATMs.

visa-preparation.entry_summary: A Short Term Entry Permit (up to 183 days) is issued on arrival for GBP 20 cash; bring a passport valid 6 months beyond the permit, pre-arranged accommodation, funds and medical insurance including evacuation.

steps.step: Buy medical insurance with evacuation cover and book accommodation, then apply for the permit on arrival.

culture-cycles.public_holidays: Saint Helena public and Government holidays, 2027: Friday 1 January; Friday 26 March (Good Friday); Monday 29 March (Easter Monday); Monday 17 May (Whit Monday); Friday 21 May (St Helena Day); Monday 30 August (August Bank Holiday); Friday 12 November (His Majesty King Charles III's Birthday); Monday 27 December (in lieu of Boxing Day); Tuesday 28 December (in lieu of Christmas Day). Government offices are closed on these days.
